title: Proporciones y descripciones oficiales: 'formada por' y 'de doble anchura que'

sections.content: Article 4.1 of the Spanish Constitution defines the national flag with exact geometric precision: 'La bandera de España está formada por tres franjas horizontales, roja, amarilla y roja, siendo la amarilla de doble anchura que cada una de las rojas.' Article 4.2 adds that the Statutes may recognize flags and ensigns of the Autonomous Communities, which shall be used together with the flag of Spain ('se utilizarán junto a la bandera de España') on their public buildings and in their official acts.

items.spanish: La bandera de España está formada por tres franjas horizontales: roja, amarilla y roja.
items.english: The flag of Spain is formed by three horizontal stripes: red, yellow, and red.

items.spanish: La franja amarilla central es de doble anchura que cada una de las franjas rojas.
items.english: The central yellow stripe is twice the width of each of the red stripes.

items.spanish: Las banderas autonómicas se utilizan junto a la bandera de España en los edificios públicos.
items.english: Autonomic flags are used alongside the flag of Spain on public buildings.

sections.content: Watch out for the CCSE exam question on stripe widths: the yellow middle stripe is **twice as wide** ('el doble de ancha') as each of the two red stripes.
